spans.s:
(उ,) वृधु r. 1st cl. (वर्द्धते)
To increase or grow.
r. 10th cl. (वर्द्धयति)
1 To shine.
2 To speak.

m. (-नः)
A man.
E.
वृध to grow or increase, aff. असानच्.

m. (-नुः)
1 A man.
2 A leaf.
3 Act, action.
E.
वृध to increase, असानु aff.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
To be increased or augmented.
E.
वृध to grow, aff. क्यप्.
